title: logic
description: Predication with evidence admitted, read proof-theoretically: the object positing generates when value enters the value-free predication cell as a charge, whose one relation is entailment (Gamma |- A). It refines the potential predication cell positing maps out of by admitting evidence and studying what that evidence licenses.

admittedEvidence.description: the value positing admits as evidence; how this charge is allowed to behave is what splits logic into its systems

entailment.description: the one relation, consequence: Gamma |- A, the conclusion A follows from assumptions Gamma by licensed steps; an arrow is an entailment (Curry-Howard-Lambek)
